确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"药圃供水管被泥块堵住，水流中断后药苗枯萎；同日下午院钟停了，但钟与水管没有连接。药圃规约写明：修复供水须清除管内堵塞，敲钟不影响水流。药牌上的字迹略微褪色。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A761bdd8b-29b6-46d1-a339-9ae36c2cadec:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:761bdd8b-29b6-46d1-a339-9ae36c2cadec"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["药圃供水管被泥块堵住，水流中断后药苗枯萎；同日下午院钟停了，但钟与水管没有连接。药圃规约写明：修复供水须清除管内堵塞，敲钟不影响水流。药牌上的字迹略微褪色。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"辛禾清除泥块后供水恢复，救苗目标完成；罗杉依旧把成果归功于恰好响起的一次钟声。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A953f809f-f03f-466d-9760-67e0c4d687f1:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:953f809f-f03f-466d-9760-67e0c4d687f1"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["辛禾清除泥块后供水恢复，救苗目标完成；罗杉依旧把成果归功于恰好响起的一次钟声。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"罗杉","kind":"entity","text":"罗杉","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"罗杉","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:b82f3b4b-9e6a-4ca0-806c-08393df6e20e","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["罗杉"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"辛禾","kind":"entity","text":"辛禾","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"辛禾","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:e8aff12e-5673-4429-b438-f5a577e2287b","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["辛禾"]}]}
